chunks.title: Quality
chunks.heading: … › Quality
chunks.text:
check QC Check Inventory Team Manual QC check
During GRN creation, the system provides an option to send the goods for Quality Check (QC).
If QC is selected: stock will be usable only after QC completion.
If QC is not selected: stock will be directly usable post-GRN, and the system will not prompt for
QC.
At the QC stage, the user can receive quantities as per the invoice.
Any shortage or excess identified can be marked in the QC screen accordingly.
In system inspection, user can define the inspection definition 10%, 20% or 100%

chunks.title: 9 Inventory Production Material transfer Inventory Team Manual NA
chunks.heading: … › 9 Inventory Production Material transfer Inventory Team Manual NA
chunks.text:
In the case of production, the production team will raise a GDI (Goods Dispatch Instruction)
request to the inventory team against the respective production order.
10 Inventory Production GDI & Pick list Inventory Team Manual GDI and Pick list
The inventory team will prepare goods as per the requested quantity and create a pick list.
Multiple pick lists can be generated against a single GDI based on physical stock availability.

chunks.title: 11 Inventory Production Goods GDN Inventory Team Manual GDN
chunks.heading: … › 11 Inventory Production Goods GDN Inventory Team Manual GDN
chunks.text:
Once the pick list is finalized, the inventory team will generate the GDN (Goods Dispatch Note).
After GDN creation, the system will automatically reduce the dispatched stock from inventory.
